entries.title: Proverbs 23:1
segments: ¶When you take your seat at the feast with a ruler, give thought with care to what is before you;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:2
segments: And put a knife to your throat, if you have a strong desire for food.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:3
segments: Have no desire for his delicate food, for it is the bread of deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:4
segments: ¶Take no care to get wealth; let there be an end to your desire for money.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:5
segments: Are your eyes lifted up to it? it is gone: for wealth takes to itself wings, like an eagle in flight up to heaven.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:6
segments: ¶Do not take the food of him who has an evil eye, or have any desire for his delicate meat:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:7
segments: For as the thoughts of his heart are, so is he: Take food and drink, he says to you; but his heart is not with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:8
segments: The food which you have taken will come up again, and your pleasing words will be wasted.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:9
segments: ¶Say nothing in the hearing of a foolish man, for he will put no value on the wisdom of your words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:10
segments: ¶Do not let the landmark of the widow be moved, and do not go into the fields of those who have no father;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:11
segments: For their saviour is strong, and he will take up their cause against you.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:12
segments: ¶Give your heart to teaching, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:13
segments: Do not keep back training from the child: for even if you give him blows with the rod, it will not be death to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:14
segments: Give him blows with the rod, and keep his soul safe from the underworld.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:15
segments: My son, if your heart becomes wise, I, even I, will be glad in heart;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:16
segments: And my thoughts in me will be full of joy when your lips say right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:17
segments: ¶Have no envy of sinners in your heart, but keep in the fear of the Lord all through the day;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:18
segments: For without doubt there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:19
segments: ¶Give ear, my son, and be wise, guiding your heart in the right way.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:20
segments: Do not be among those who give themselves to wine-drinking, or among those who make themselves full with meat:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:21
segments: For those who take delight in drink and feasting will come to be in need; and through love of sleep a man will be poorly clothed.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:22
segments: Give ear to your father whose child you are, and do not keep honour from your mother when she is old.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:23
segments: Get for yourself that which is true, and do not let it go for money; get wisdom and teaching and good sense.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:24
segments: The father of the upright man will be glad, and he who has a wise child will have joy because of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:25
segments: Let your father and your mother be glad, let her who gave you birth have joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:26
segments: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes take delight in my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:27
segments: For a loose woman is a deep hollow, and a strange woman is a narrow water-hole.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:28
segments: Yes, she is waiting secretly like a beast for its food, and deceit by her is increased among men.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:29
segments: ¶Who says, Oh! who says, Ah! who has violent arguments, who has grief, who has wounds without cause, whose eyes are dark?

entries.title: Proverbs 23:30
segments: Those who are seated late over the wine: those who go looking for mixed wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:31
segments: Keep your eyes from looking on the wine when it is red, when its colour is bright in the cup, when it goes smoothly down:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:32
segments: In the end, its bite is like that of a snake, its wound like the wound of a poison-snake.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:33
segments: Your eyes will see strange things, and you will say twisted things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:34
segments: Yes, you will be like him who takes his rest on the sea, or on the top of a sail-support.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:35
segments: They have overcome me, you will say, and I have no pain; they gave me blows without my feeling them: when will I be awake from my wine? I will go after it again.
